target_customer: Recruiters and hiring managers who source candidates through personal networks and social platforms
problem: Hiring managers share open roles across LinkedIn, Slack and Twitter and lose track of referrals. Talentdrop gave each a personal hiring page that tracks sharing and referrals in one place.
business_model: SaaS for recruiters, with a referral bounty marketplace described in one write-up

founders.name: Maddy Nguyen
education: Washington University in St. Louis, law degree
founders.background_notes: In-house recruiter 2013 to 2019 per the YC page.

founders.name: Janelle Tiulentino
founders.background_notes: Scholarship student per the YC page.

competitors.name: Intrro
competitors.what: London employee referral platform that involves employees in hiring

technical_complexity.rationale: A web app that generates shareable role pages and tracks referral sources, with social integrations, is standard CRUD engineering.

defensibility.rationale: No network effects or data lock-in are described, and LinkedIn and applicant tracking vendors offer referral features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: LinkedIn already offered Referrals and Recruiter tools; no copy or acquisition event specific to Talentdrop was found.

market_need_then: Venture funding for HR tech reached over $9.2B between January and October 2021 per search coverage, and several referral startups launched in 2021.

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings were found; no press, community or brand specific evidence.

outcome_analysis: Talentdrop was a three person San Francisco team of ex-Snapchat people offering personal hiring pages and referral tracking, accepted in YC Summer 2021. A separate write-up describes an open referral bounty marketplace, suggesting the product shifted, but this is undated. YC lists it inactive and no shutdown notice, cause or acquirer is public, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: talentdrop.com returned HTTP 503 so the site could not be read. The seed round, its date and investor names rest on CB Insights alone (130K total over 3 rounds); amount is a single database figure. Founding year 2019 per YC, 2018 per another directory. The bounty marketplace description comes from a third party write-up whose date is unknown. Competitor Intrro source is dated November 2021, a few months after the batch; Candidate.io predates it.
